messages:
asha: Quick idea — ran the KB sweep and found ~18 broken links across a few sections. Thinking a tiny bounty (internal $50 credit) per fixed doc to speed up claims. Anyone want to take a batch? :moneybag:

kb-bot: scan report: 18 failures detected. top paths: /guides/runtime, /kb/images, /onboarding. CSV: https://internal/scans/kb-1735556667.csv

devon: happy to take 5 runtime docs. will open PRs today. @sara can you review when ready?

matt: +1. if you claim, drop the PR link here and add the `docs-bounty` label. put a one-line note in the PR describing the fix. :thumbsup:

asha: label created: docs-bounty. tiny request — include a before/after snippet in the PR description (helps reviewers). example quick replace for old CDN paths:
```
sed -i 's|https://cdn-old.company.com/|https://cdn.kb.company.com/|g' docs/runtime/*.md
```

sara: I can review devon's PRs tomorrow morning. will do a quick content-check and sanity the links. cc @liam for any image rehosts.

liam: if you're touching images, ping me. I can rehost assets in /assets-kb and update references in a batch. avoids repeated uploads.

devon: claimed files: runtime/actor-cache.md, runtime/kv-cache.md, runtime/compilation-notes.md, runtime/seq-limits.md, runtime/deploy-tips.md. PRs: https://git/repo/pull/123 and https://git/repo/pull/124 — used the sed above and fixed a couple of anchor names. marking here so others don't duplicate. :white_check_mark:

kb-bot: noted claim(s). will re-run scan in 24h and post delta to this thread.

asha: awesome — thanks devon & sara & liam. matt — can we make a 1-week rotation rule for low-effort docs fixes after this sprint? keeps velocity up and spreads context.

matt: added to backlog as "docs-bounty rotation" under product triage. I'll loop in growth for the internal credits flow. thanks everyone! :rocket:
